thread:
Marta (sales): Quick sync — CedarHealth signed the MSA and needs a tight DD packet for procurement. They asked specifically for: SOC2 excerpts, an on-letterhead pen-test attestation (external scan), and a note about Dedicated pricing delta with KMS options. Procurement wants this by Fri COB.

Jon S (solutions): I can assemble POC deliverables. Two quick infra checks: 1) staging in us-west2 ok? 2) they need static egress IPs and an optional CMK flow. We have a standard IP allowlist and a KMS onboarding doc.

Priya K (security): Us-west2 is fine. For pen-test attestation: confirm scope = external-only? If yes, we can provide our signed vendor attestation. If they insist on internal testing evidence, that's additional work. Also note: SOC2 full report is confidential; we only share an executive summary + redacted control matrix excerpt.

Marta (sales): They said external-only for now. Might request internal later. Also asked whether Dedicated (single-tenant) adds any compliance artifacts.

Sam L (legal): We have a vendor pen-test letter template. If they require it on letterhead with a signature block we can route to Ops for signature. Link: https://redwood-internal.company/legal/pen-test-letter-template.pdf

procurement-bot: SOC2 summary artifact path: https://redwood-secure/docs/soc2/executive-summary-v2.txt (access restricted)

Priya K (security): Deliverable list I propose to build into the zip: 1) SOC2 Type II executive summary (redacted), 2) Control matrix excerpt (redacted), 3) Network diagram (hosted + dedicated), 4) Pen-test attestation (template, will request signature), 5) Staging IP allowlist + sample curl test, 6) KMS onboarding checklist (if CMK requested), 7) Short note: "POC staging environment not covered by production SLAs." I can have this bundle by Thu EOD.

Jon S (solutions): For the POC runbook I'll include a connectivity checklist and creds rotation notes. Example snippet to verify connectivity:
curl -v https://staging.redwood-usw2.example/api/v1/health -H 'Authorization: Bearer <poc_token>'
I'll also add the bastion IP and the presigned S3 path (24h).

Marta (sales): Pricing — CedarHealth is evaluating Dedicated: spec requested = 2x A100-equivalent, ~2TB RAM, 3mo reservation. Needs both monthly delta and one-time setup number. Pricing asked for an itemized line they can drop into an internal PO.

Sam L (legal): Pricing team: please provide a clean line item and a short legal caveat re: audit support scope. I can attach the caveat to the quote.

Priya K (security): Operational note: if they pick CMK (customer-managed key), KMS onboarding adds ~48-72h and requires a signed key policy and proof of KMS ARN. I'll include a mini-checklist.

Jon S (solutions): I'll provision the staging tenant and create the runbook by Thu morning. Will post the static IPs and the sample tests.

Marta (sales): I'll tell CedarHealth: bundle by Thu, signed pen-test letter by Fri (subject to legal sign-off), Dedicated quote by Thu EOD. Tagging @Sam L for legal sign once Priya posts the final attestation wording.

Sam L (legal): Got it. Once Priya confirms wording I'll route for signature. Also request the signed one-page PoC scope from the customer so we can tie the attestation to the right engagement.

Marta (sales): On it — sending the PoC scope request now.
